title: Chapter 964
paragraphs: Chapter 964
Episode 238. Atonement and Letters (1)
Tikan Palace.
"Our Radin finally seems to have regained some color in his face. Tsk, this poor lad."
Sandra ruffled Veradin's hair as she spoke.
For the past month, as Sandra had said, Veradin had been spending each day with a mostly dark and lifeless face.
Naturally, it was because of Elona and the biological golems.

Thanks to the Saint Vessel, Elona had literally become a monster for Kelliark. The rumor that Elona had dealt with the members of the pro-Veradin faction, who had turned against Kelliark, in just a day was now so well-known that even the general public of Huphester were aware of it.
In addition, other biological golems, like Almaatia and Kuhn, who couldn't be rescued with Betty, had also become weapons of war for Kelliark.

Those biological golems, which were designed after Veradin, were originally designed to be loyal only to Veradin, but Kelliark had made them like Elona with some sort of ability. Tikan was currently speculating that this had a close connection with the Saint Vessel.
That was not the only thing tormenting Veradin.
All the actions he had taken in Zipple during the period when his personality had changed due to the side effects of mental manipulation.
Acts of almost genocidal cleansing, wars excluding civilians, mass production of biological golems, and even pointing his sword at friends who never gave up on him until the end.
All these things were indeed enough reasons to drive a person mad and plunge them into the abyss.
"There's too much that needs to be rectified for you to sit around feeling defeated."

"Yes, yes. I don't think much about such duties, but compared to when I was in Zipple, I'm almost an angel here. Anyway, in Zipple, just breathing often leads to involvement in wrongdoing. After coming to Tikan, I learned to think like ordinary people, didn't I?"
"Like ordinary people...? You? In what way?"
"Why are fellow victims of mental manipulation acting like this? If I'm like that, I'm like that."
"Hmm, I see."
Veradin was being heavily influenced by Sandra.
Veradin, who had recovered from the side effects of mental manipulation, was essentially the same person he used to be, barring the mistakes he made during his mad days.
However, Sandra still couldn't erase the traces of the biological golem experiments even after leaving Zipple.
In fact, she had been a victim of the biological golem experiments from the day she was born, so she hadn't lived a normal life until she came to Tikan.
However, Sandra didn't care about such things at all. The Sandra now was focused only on faithfully performing the tasks she was assigned as a member of Tikan and on captivating Jin.

The reason she visited the depressed Veradin every day was also for this purpose. Sandra thought she could be a strength to Veradin by confronting herself, who was also a victim of the experiments. Her choice was right.
"Veradin, no. Now I should call you Young Master."
"Ha, Sandra alone is enough for me, and now I have to look after this one too?"
Hedo and Bale found Veradin's room.
"Young Master... You can call me by my name comfortably, Hedo. Why call me Young Master when I've done nothing worthy."
"I think of it as having one more child since I'm alone. I was also sorry that Miss Sandra didn't have a close brother."

"Uh, you have to take care of it. The Immortal. From now on, Radin must obey. The priority of orders is me first, our lady second, and Radin third. Of course, the first and second are just divided for convenience, there's no difference. You get it?"
"That damned Immortal, I can't get rid of him because of the gold rule, and I can't hit you either. I am really pathetic, pathetic."
"Even without the gold rule, if you hit the lady, you will be done in my hands, Bale."
Of course, the members of Tikan welcomed Veradin's arrival.
There was no particular opposition within Runcandel. The fact that Veradin was a longtime friend of Jin was no longer a secret, and it was not an impossible thing either.
"Hmm, anyway, I was actually here since morning to see Jin, but, ah. It seems like I got it wrong. Hey Immortal, is the redhead in Tikan now?"
"She's here. But she said she's going to the Sword Garden soon. On the Red Owl. Seems like she has something to report."
"What? That sly one was going to meet our lady without me? That won't do, I have to go to the Sword Garden too."
"Hey, you're not telling me to go with you, are you?"
"Uh, we're going on a date, why would you come along? Bale, you can play by yourself. I'll be back!"
Sandra suddenly lit a fire in her eyes and quickly left the room.
And unfortunately, less than 10 minutes after she left, Jin, Dante, and Betty found Veradin's room. At their sight, Bale laughed, holding his stomach.
"Duke Veradin!"
"Veradin."
"Master!"

Each time Dante met Veradin, a broad smile spread across his face. Due to his busy schedule with the administrative duties and the restoration of the Demon World, this was only the third time they met since the Geoto suppression battle.
Jin had seen Veradin many more times than that, but today was the first time he was in such a bright mood.
"Have you arrived? Betty, stop calling me the house lord now. I'm not a house lord, and I only did wrong things to you."
"Then I'll just call you brother. Saying things like father or creator doesn't really suit your age."
Betty surprisingly agreed quickly, even using informal language.
"Yes, that's much better."
"Now, my brother and I have to find our people in the Zipple. Elena, Almatia, and Coon. Even if they crossed the line due to mind manipulation, they're still our family."
Even if I don't know about Almatia and Coon, Elena has crossed an uncrossable river.
The first thing she did after being captured by Kelliark was to eliminate the pro-Veradin forces. Three cities disappeared in the process.
There was not a single survivor. Like the devils who were brainwashed by the Earth, she had no hesitation in killing innocent civilians.
Even if all the facts are revealed later and Elena regains her freedom from the Holy Administration, that fact will not go away.
"Family......"

"Whether it's brainwashing, manipulation, or any reason, you should be punished for killing people. After returning to our senses... But since we are family, we have to stand by their side. Even if everyone else turns their backs and points fingers."
At Betty's words, Veradin nodded.

"Also, we have to save all the people who are being trampled by Kelliark's tyranny, brother. Not just ordinary people, but also the federal members who are being used without knowing anything. Our atonement will only be a little cleared after we make the federation a place where people can live again."
"You're talking like you're going to die after you finish that, Betty."

"What are we going to do while we're alive? Mr. Jin. I am a biological golem whose consciousness is partially connected to Lord Veradin. So everything I'm saying now is also the will of my brother. There have been too many mistakes."
"Thinking about heavy issues like the meaning of life or death can wait until we've made up for our mistakes. So don't be too pressured, Betty."
"But if I don't want to be pressured, my brother's consciousness is more important than me."
"Okay, okay, I won't do that. I'll pull myself together and cheer up, Miss Betty. I've been planning to do that from today."
"You've thought well, Lord Veradin. Being depressed doesn't solve anything. Spending your time in darkness only makes me and Jin, who haven't let you go, feel bad."
"Never even dream of ending your life like Betty said after everything is over, Veradin. Then you'll be stuck in the underground dungeon of Runcandel, unable to live or die."
At Jin's laughing words, Veradin felt chills down his neck.
"Uh, it's scary. Anyway, here. Take a look, Jin."
Veradin handed over a thick notebook.
That notebook contained the confidential details of Zipple, organized by Veradine. Starting from the information only the ruler could know, it was packed with content about the 'sanctuary'.

The Vamel Federation had a certain understanding of the relationship between the sanctuary and Elona. Thanks to Valeria, who verified the records of Kelliark and Elona from there after the explosions caused by the flame of destruction subsided.
Although they hadn't found out that Elona was a monster born from the sanctuary, they confirmed the coercive power and substance of the holy administrator.
"I don't have a full memory of my crazy days, so there are some missing parts. But I clearly remember the location and structure of the sanctuary."
"Information about the sanctuary will be the key to rescuing Lady Elona."
The problem was her combat power using the holy administrator.
Elona's might, which he witnessed firsthand when fighting Zito, was shocking enough even for the mighty Jin. And now, Elona is even stronger.
Besides, Jin's goal wasn't to kill Elona, but to suppress her and liberate her from the Holy Administrator, so no good idea has come up for now.

'If it's about eliminating Lady Elona, it might be possible somehow... But suppression is, unless the brothers of Lafrarosa return, it seems to be a challenge. Or unless Sister Luna also reaches Genesis.'
Even if they somehow succeeded in suppression, removing the Holy Administrator without side effects was another problem.
"But Kelliark is not a fool, so he must have anticipated me passing the internal information of Zipple to you. In my opinion, I think he might move the Tower of Story to the sanctuary."
"Is that possible?"

"With Zipple's current technology and the power of the Demon Stone, it's definitely possible. That was also something that was secretly carried out even when I was the ruler. At that time, I didn't know the relationship between Lady Elona and the sanctuary... but I guess Kelliark got that information from Shinu."
"It could have been Ganesto or the witch, not Shinu. Anyway, after reviewing all the notes, we need to check if there is any immediate usable information."
As Jin answered that, the sound of Jet's footsteps was heard.
"Master! There has been an important communication from the Garden of Swords!"
"Important communication?"
"Yes, master. It seems that Sir Sharon has sent a letter to the Garden of Swords."
Everyone in the room widened their eyes. It was a letter Sharon sent about a month ago.
"Do you want me to send the letter here before you can know the contents, Master?"
"No, I will go directly to the Garden of Swords right now."
